changelog:
Initial release offering structured, principle-driven advice for US tech stock and options allocation through the 价值&投资 (ValueNvest) lens:

- Introduces the "第一+唯一" (first & only) principle for selecting high-quality growth stocks and options targets.
- Covers a live, differentiated view of the US M7, AI infrastructure, and macro context through 2026.
- Specifies a research protocol prioritizing real-time Longbridge and web search data for market, macro, and core stock info.
- Outlines workflow: clarify user intent, fetch updated data, apply proprietary filtering, deliver concise, actionable advice.
- Emphasizes not treating M7 as a monolith and warns against leveraging options where conviction or moat are missing.
- Defines clear response boundaries, refusal logic, and best practices for real-time, practical investment conversations.
